A three-way jump: one compare, three targets

Compare two registers once and jump on the trit: less, equal or greater. A binary machine needs two tests for the same branch.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/ternary/trits.t27 (t27#8979): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js), with 18 tests and 4108 runtime asserts
  • N. P. Brusentsov and others, the Setun computer, Moscow State University, 1958: a working balanced-ternary machine
